candidates.sentence: But at this moment, I think the opportunity to serve in the Senate will allow us to do that work on a deeper level and at the same time focus on things like freedom, our reproductive freedom […].

As a matter of fact, even in the last election, Republicans came up to me and said, ‘You know, this is unacceptable.’ When [Donald Trump] bragged about taking away [abortion] rights, trust that he [will] do it again. […] He has talked about punishing women, and this is one of the reasons why the Senate is important because we need to codify Roe v.
